concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a fully developed Greek mythology town screen for Pantheon Realms, in the rich hand-painted over pre-rendered 3D aesthetic of Heroes of Might and Magic III town screens. Wide landscape 3:2 composition, no UI, text, labels or borders. A coherent inhabited coastal Greek polis, warm late afternoon light from upper left, restrained limestone ivory, terracotta, bronze and deep blue. Elevated frontal oblique camera, not a top-down board. Aegean sea to left, mountains beyond, cypress trees, stepped rock terraces, small non-interactive houses connecting districts. Architecture clearly legible, crisp silhouettes, moderate contrast background and strongest contrast on buildings. Exactly 18 distinct gameplay landmarks, all visible with separate readable silhouettes, arranged organically: hilltop center Pantheon Temple, a great classical columned temple; upper right Sanctum, tall blue-roofed mystical tower; far right ridge Watchtower with bronze armillary sphere; upper middle Civic Capitol, grand colonnaded palace; center left Tavern terracotta courtyard inn; center right Artifact Merchant blue-awning domed shop; central lower Agora Marketplace with colorful stalls and fountain; lower right Training Academy colonnaded gymnasium; lower left Workshop furnace and tools; beside workshop Resource Depot warehouses and amphorae; very bottom center Fortifications monumental gate with wall wings framing foreground; lower middle right Barracks rectangular fortified courtyard; right of barracks Peltast Range with targets; upper far right cliff Griffin Aerie with perched griffins; middle left Training Court equestrian enclosure; far left middle House of Adepts small scholarly temple; middle far right Labyrinth maze entrance carved into hillside with visible maze court; far left lower Thunder Quarry enormous stone blocks, cyclopean forge and restrained storm glow. No circular building pads, no floating islands, no evenly spaced grid. Buildings integrated with roads, stairways, terrain and coherent shadows, modest overlap only. Complete city at maximum development, compelling fantasy atmosphere, architecture rather than huge creatures dominates.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target: the Greek coastal city concept. Produce its clean reusable BACKGROUND PLATE with the exact same 3:2 framing, camera, horizon, perspective, lighting, sea, distant mountains and colors. Remove ALL 18 prominent interactive landmarks: hilltop temple; blue magical tower; armillary watchtower; central palace; tavern; blue-domed merchant; market stalls and fountain; gymnasium; forge workshop; warehouses; entire foreground gatehouse and connected wall wings; barracks; archery enclosure; griffins and their nest platforms; horse training court; small left scholarly temple; hedge labyrinth and its entrance; quarry machinery, cut blocks and lightning. Replace their footprints with continuous natural limestone ground, understated irregular paved terraces and dirt, connecting streets and stairs. Preserve the natural cliffs and their broad shape, cypresses, small incidental non-interactive houses, vegetation, sea and boats, distant city and mountains. Ground must look natural, no circular pads or markers, no conspicuous holes, no large landmark buildings remaining, no text. This is the terrain underneath detachable buildings. Do not move the camera or crop.
